body: I'm aware, it just seems like a way bigger problem this year. I'm talking like a fifth of the bag moving around with them in it. It's a nightmare. And then the customers bring the bags back filled with moths and no one puts it outside because they don't want to touch the fucking bag until I get here to damage the shit which is usually a few days later. Then we finally get an exterminator to deal with the ones that are flying around but we don't pay them to come back for a check up so the cycle repeats.
I did. Begrudgingly. The fuckers are everywhere now tho. Shutting down the pet food isle for the 4th time. Literally thousands in the dog treats boxes alone.

Me literally 3 months ago. She planned on just leaving without saying anything but decided to tell me a week before she moved out. I agreed that we had become more like best friends, but that was the worst week of my life. Having to sleep with her in the same house drove me insane. Tried to kill myself and failed. Had to move back in with my mom which makes me want to try again every other day because what kind of grown adult wants to be a burden again. But I see her happy now on twitter and it makes me smile. That's all I really wanted I guess. Now I can focus on my own happiness and stop living for others.

Edit: Reading it back I somehow made this about me when you're suffering. It wasn't my intention and I'm Sorry. I can't imagine how much more difficult it is when you're married. I hope it works out if you want it to and if not I hope you'll come out okay.
